description: This Java interface defines the configuration contract for the 'Things' service within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends multiple configuration-related interfaces, specifies a method for message logging, and contains an embedded enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: ThingsConfig
classes.description: Interface that declares configuration options for the 'Things' service, including a method for message logging and a nested enum for configuration defaults.

classes.name: ThingsConfig.ThingsConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values specific to the 'Things' configuration.

methods.name: isLogIncomingMessages
methods.description: Indicates whether all incoming messages should be logged for tracing purposes.

methods.name: getThingConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration settings specific to 'thing' entities.
